content.title: uniQure (QURE) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: As you know, in the third quarter, we announced positive top-line data from our pivotal Phase 1/2 study of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, the first gene therapy to demonstrate statistically significant slowing of disease progression in Huntington's disease.  As previously disclosed, we met with the FDA in late October to review our data and discuss the potential submission of a BLA for AMT-130.
